scope: Development reachability study: does the frozen C36 problem reach the training and physical gates when only the L-BFGS budget grows? Seeds 361901/361902 were observed in v1, so no result here is a formal time-to-accuracy claim.

training.start: fresh original initialization; no direct-velocity checkpoints
training.stop_rule: none; the full budget runs and the first closure meeting both training limits is recorded with its parameters
training.engine: both: packed activation with analytic transpose, and parameter AD over the same packed forward; each compiled with CUDA Graph replay of the complete loss and gradient
training.gradient_reference: dense eager C36 parameter AD (chunk 128); preserved full native AD at the original parameters

physical.state_observer: native coordinate AD of the trained curl-potential network

saved_state: scheduled checkpoints, the first training-gate closure and all loss/gradient events
gradient_checks: every 50 L-BFGS calls and at scheduled Adam updates
changes_from_v1.unchanged: data, calibration, eta, model, normalization, Adam schedule, L-BFGS settings, seeds, training limits and every physical gate

physical_observation.note: Per lane. LBFGS-call20 is the v1 budget point. An observation starts only if the lane budget and the allocation deadline both allow its estimated duration; skipped observations are recorded.

decision_rule.a: Loss stays above 1e-4: the problem is budget-, capacity- or sampling-limited at this scale; no formal v3 on budget alone.
decision_rule.b: Loss passes 1e-4 but physical errors stop falling: training objective or sampling does not control the physical gates; change the problem definition explicitly in a new protocol.
decision_rule.c: Physical gates pass: freeze a formal v3 with new seeds generated and stored on the cluster runtime and both engines (compiled packed analytic and equally compiled parameter AD) for time to accepted accuracy.

execution.allocation: one new ACC node, 3 h, four H100 GPUs; one lane per (seed, engine), all four concurrent
execution.start_command: embedded in the batch script; the cluster-side driver runs admission, training, observation, reader and archive

paired_development_analysis.statistic: per seed, parameter_ad/analytic ratios of training seconds to first reach loss 1e-3, 3e-4 and 1e-4, and of mean seconds per evaluation
paired_development_analysis.status: development only: seeds observed in v1, two concurrent lanes per engine on one node; not a formal time-to-accuracy result
